metadata.description: Claude Code plugins maintained by Hantsch.

plugins.name: ai-scrum
plugins.description: Installs a spec-driven AI Scrum workflow into your repository: roadmap -> concept -> story -> refine -> build -> sprint. Commands, agents and state all live in the project, so the plugin is only needed to install and update them.

plugins.name: tech-rules
plugins.description: Installs the house rules for a project's tech stack into the repository itself: /tech-rules:setup detects the stack and writes the matching skills to .claude/skills/, maintains a managed block in CLAUDE.md and keeps both up to date. Contributors need no plugin - the rules are in the repo.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic building blocks for every project: the output styles Briefing and KIS, and the premortem and secrets-scan commands.
